goal: Ratify exact macOS artifact, custody, publication and launch requirements.
description: Scope: macOS Requirements.md and target catalog entries. Context: current acceptance, receipts and native authorization disagree. Target: approve REQ-MAC-001..004 as the complete macOS child contract. Design Considerations: GitHub Release consumer verification and optional platform publication are separate typed receipts. Design Value: authenticates the official GitHub artifact without importing store authority. Constraints & Risks: real signing, notarization and platform publication remain external channel-only inputs.

goal: Reproduce macOS artifact-kind, self-test, support and Keychain authorization blockers.
description: Scope: macOS Evidence.md, workflow, acceptance/receipt config, distribution helpers and secret store. Context: fresh self-tests fail and the native store silently downgrades. Target: bind every macOS blocker to current source or a fresh command and list external gaps. Design Considerations: distinguish GitHub Release consumer verification, physical security proof, and optional channel status. Design Value: platform work starts from current facts. Constraints & Risks: do not access signing secrets or retain machine-specific output.

goal: Freeze digest-linked macOS build, authorization and publication validation.
description: Scope: macOS Validation.md and child receipt schema. Context: local and production checks validate different artifacts and identities. Target: one matrix covers target rejection, clean build, Keychain/LocalAuthentication, install/launch and consumer verification; optional Developer ID, notarization, publication and continuity checks produce a separate channel status. Design Considerations: every stage names one digest and source revision. Design Value: GitHub Release and channel status are independently rerunnable. Constraints & Risks: external channel stages stay unready until authorized without blocking GitHub Release.

acceptance_criteria.text: Validation maps every macOS requirement to positive, failure and exact-artifact checks, including parent/shared dependency ids.

goal: Establish one macOS distribution lineage and one native authorization owner.
description: Scope: macOS Architecture.md, distribution producer/verifier and native authorization port. Context: ZIP/app-bundle and protected/ordinary store semantics diverge. Target: one immutable ZIP manifest and bounded LocalAuthentication session handle implement the parent contracts. Design Considerations: ports/adapters and typed unavailable or memory-only facts. Design Value: eliminates ambiguous artifact and custody authority. Constraints & Risks: implementation removes superseded kinds and silent fallback in one pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture names one owner and failure state for artifact verification, authorization, install and launch receipts, plus a separate owner for optional platform-channel receipts.

goal: Unify macOS target catalog, distribution ZIP, manifest and verifier lineage.
description: Scope: target catalog, build-macos-distribution, bundle verifier, acceptance and receipt config. Context: current artifact kinds and positive fixtures mismatch. Target: each declared architecture produces one ZIP whose app and native binaries bind the parent source/profile schema. Design Considerations: content-addressed manifest and exact typed dispatcher. Design Value: every later receipt verifies the same object. Constraints & Risks: delete app-bundle aliases and stale fixtures after migration.

acceptance_criteria.text: Clean builds and self-tests pass for declared targets, while kind, architecture, profile, source and digest substitutions fail.

goal: Make macOS Keychain custody fail closed under one LocalAuthentication session.
description: Scope: secure_mesh_secret_store, macOS bridge, capability facts and integration tests. Context: noninteractive or unavailable LocalAuthentication silently falls back to ordinary keyring and still reports available. Target: one user action creates a bounded user-presence context for all related operations; unavailable protection yields typed memory-only or unavailable state. Design Considerations: opaque session handles and explicit close/expiry. Design Value: enforces client authorization without repeated prompts. Constraints & Risks: background work never prompts; remove unused environment-policy projection and generic fallback.

acceptance_criteria.text: Real and integration cases prove success, denial, cancellation, unavailable interaction, background access, expiry and delete with no ordinary-store downgrade.
